title: VL53L9CX - Post Processing Technical Note  (TN1596)
content:
In Section 5.1 of datasheet for VL53L9CX, it says 
“Refer to the postprocessing technical note (TN1596) for more details of the data formatting, processing, and
filter functions.”

But I cant seem to find the TN1596 document. I am looking for information on the distortion correction on the raw depth output.

scraped_replies.html:
Hi:

This technical specification document is a confidential ST document and is not currently released to the public. In addition, if you have a solid project and can contact our FAE or sales for detailed information. Thank you for your attention.

Best regards,

Bin FAN
